name.es: Tornillo de cabeza de botón M5x10
name.pt: Parafuso de cabeça de botão M5x10

description.en: An ISO 7380-1 hexagon socket button head screw, M5 × 10 mm: the head bears on a host's face or counterbore floor and the shank passes its clearance hole into a thread under it, such as a T-nut in a 2020 slot.
description.es: Un tornillo de cabeza de botón con hexágono interior ISO 7380-1, M5 × 10 mm: la cabeza apoya en la cara o en el fondo del avellanado de una pieza anfitriona y el vástago pasa por su barreno de paso hacia una rosca debajo, como una tuerca en T en una ranura 2020.
description.fr: Une vis à tête bombée à six pans creux ISO 7380-1, M5 × 10 mm : la tête porte sur la face ou le fond de lamage d'une pièce hôte et la tige traverse son trou de passage vers un filetage en dessous, comme un écrou en T dans une rainure 2020.
description.pt: Um parafuso de cabeça de botão com sextavado interno ISO 7380-1, M5 × 10 mm: a cabeça apoia na face ou no fundo do rebaixo de uma peça hospedeira e a haste passa pelo furo de passagem até uma rosca por baixo, como uma porca em T numa ranhura 2020.

governing.designation: ISO 7380-1 hexagon socket button head screw M5x10

sources.title: DIN EN ISO 7380-1 button head screw with hexagon socket, M5x10, 010.9 (product datasheet 157380510)
sources.supports: ISO 7380-1 M5x10: d 5 mm; l 10 mm; head diameter dk 9.5 mm; head height k 2.75 mm; hexagon socket s 3; socket depth t 1.56 mm

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 19 (Frame): M5x10 BHCS, M5 shim and M5 T-nut fix the bed extrusions; pp. 42–43 (Z drive): M5x10 BHCS fix the Z drive to the frame; p. 7 (Hardware reference): BHCS per ISO 7380-1

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the under-head bearing face, on the screw axis. +z runs along the shank to the tip at z = 10; the head lies on the −z side. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the screw is round, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

label.es: Asiento de la cabeza (bajo la cabeza)
label.fr: Appui de la tête (sous la tête)

interfaces.note: Male: the shank enters the host's clearance hole. As bhcs-m5x30: the origin is the centre of the under-head face and the normal points +z along the shank toward the host, so a hole framed at the head seat with its normal out of the hole takes the screw head on that face.

envelope.note: Head and shank; the hex socket is not hollowed. The shank overlaps the hole or T-nut it is driven into: declare it.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: No journal interface: at 10 mm the screw is a fastener, not an axle. The thread it engages (a T-nut, a tapped end) is mated by the host's m5-screw-joint interface, not by the screw. Length variants are separate entries, as bhcs-m5x30.
